title: US Heavy Equipment Arrives in Baltics
description:
1. (00:00) Establishing shot of riga docks.
2. (00:04) Various of the ships name, "Liberty Promise".
3. (00:12) Two shot from behind Latvian MOV CON soldiers.
4. (00:17) Various showing the vehicles inside the ship with visiting dignitaries.
5. (00:29) Dignitaries exiting the ship.
6. (00:33) US Army General O'Connor talking to a US soldier.
7. (00:37) Various of US heavy equipment being driven off the ship.
8. (01:48) Pan left to right following a US vehicle and then panning up to the "Liberty" writing on side of ship.
9. (01:57) Various of media and visiting dignitaries.
10. (02:13) Various of the US and Latvian MOV CON.
11. (02:23) Major General John R. O'Connor: We’ve got the 3rd Infantry coming into the Baltic states, who are going to train with the NATO Alliance as well as our partner nations so they can get comfortable with working shoulder to shoulder as they have for the past decade in Iraq and Afghanistan and now we’re going to demonstrate that same resolve as we lean forward and demonstrate to Russia and to Putin that we are not broken in our efforts to stand together through this type of aggression.
12. (02:49) MAJOR GENERAL JOHN R. O’CONNOR: The Liberty promise represents America’s response to building reediness and responsiveness as part of Operation Atlantic Resolve. Atlantic Resolve is a series of exercises which brings together capabilities of the United States military as well as the Baltic State military and the Black sea military so from Estonia all the way down to Bulgaria the arrival of the Liberty Promise today with US capability from the 3rd Infantry Division demonstrates that we can bring not only airborne and striker formations and armor capability but the mechanized capability today from this division and it will be incorporated into a series of multinational exercises to demonstrate our resolve for security and global co-operation with our NATO Alliance partners.
